notes.title: Save 10% on Honey, I Joined A Cult
notes.notes:
[h3]Escapists, have you ever considered managing a cult?[/h3]

To celebrate the Steam Early Access launch, we’re giving owners of The Escapists: The Walking Dead a 10% discount on Honey, I Joined A Cult! Combine that with the 10% launch week discount and you’ve got a deal of true enlightenment!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29624581/87790fc64afa6ab67c7371529d73592614c4145c.png[/img]
[i]You can also get the 10% discount if you own The Escapists, The Escapists 2, or The Survivalists![/i]

[b]What is Honey, I Joined A Cult?[/b]
In Honey, I Joined a Cult you must build and expand your base, manage your cultists and resources, and increase your faith, funds and following.

[previewyoutube=p6HGqctA5N8;full][/previewyoutube]

[u][b]Key Features:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] [b]Take full control of a funky cult:[/b] Recruit cultists to maintain the organisation’s smooth operation; keep them entertained and happy to grow its money and influence. 
[*] [b]Build ‘freaky deaky’ bases:[/b] Build the cult from the ground up and design the layout from ‘hypno-chambers’ and bathrooms to monoliths and bedrooms. 
[*] [b]Branch out into the community:[/b] Send minions out to spread the good word, or just get them to steal fancy items for your cult HQ. 
[*] [b]Stick it to ‘The Man’:[/b] Overcome threats from law enforcement, oppressive government bodies, and misinformed protesters. 
[*] [b]Get down with deities:[/b] Choose where your cult’s heading - fiery apocalypse or the second coming of the Squid Lord? 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29624581/6a6205cf2e544a7b95ad0caaf9c1cf42611c9957.png[/img]

[h3]Pledge your faith 👇[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/841190/Honey_I_Joined_a_Cult/

notes.notes:

In the meantime, you can find a couple of cryptic clues in the image above, and if you hop over to the [url=https://twitter.com/Team17Ltd/status/1134368934923296770]Team17 Twitter account[/url], make your predictions, follow and re-tweet then you’ll be entered into a prize draw to win a copy of these two games, and Hell Let Loose, upon release!

Thanks for reading, and we’ll see you next week!

notes.title: Vote for Overcooked! 2 & Yoku’s Island Express at The Game Awards!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32941731/7652de62b4c6b4d19fb973a57e1afc9520fd7348.jpg[/img]

One of the biggest events in the gaming calendar, [url=https://thegameawards.com/]The Game Awards[/url], is fast approaching and we’re extremely proud to see that not just one but TWO Team17 releases have been nominated for awards this year!

First up, chaotic co-op cooking game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/728880/Overcooked_2/]Overcooked! 2[/url] has been nominated for Best Family Game, while pinball-Metroidvania [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/334940/Yokus_Island_Express/]Yoku’s Island Express[/url] is up for Best Debut Indie Game!

It means so much to the hard-working people at the Team17 studio, as well as our Games Label partners at Ghost Town Games and Villa Gorilla to be recognised in these categories, but we’d be over the moon if they won. Maybe we’re biased, but we think they deserve it!

[b]How you can help![/b]
The Game Awards winners are decided by a mix of independent judges and fan votes, and in the case of Best Debut Indie Game – in which Yoku’s Island Express is running – the category is 100% decided by fans. 

We want to spread the word about these two great games and encourage more people to play them, and we can’t do it without you! So if you’ve played either of these gems and would like to help out then please [url=https://thegameawards.com/awards/]head to The Game Awards website and cast your vote[/url]!

Please note that it is possible to vote once per 24 hours (if you’re feeling super passionate about the awards) and doing so will increase the chances that your game of choice wins. So too will taking advantage of the option to share your choice to social media when prompted to do so.

[b]Try the Yoku’s Island Express demo![/b]
If you haven’t played Yoku’s Island Express and would like to try it before voting, there’s a free demo available on the Steam page. Why not give it a whirl and find out what all the fuss is about…

Thank you all for reading (and hopefully [url=https://thegameawards.com/awards/]voting[/url]). We’ll see you all at The Game Awards on December 6th!

notes.title: Overcooked! 2 – Get FIVE extra chefs free, when you pre-order!
notes.notes:
Overcooked returns with a brand-new helping of chaotic cooking action! Journey back to the Onion Kingdom and assemble your team of chefs in classic couch co-op or online play for up to four players. Hold onto your aprons… It’s time to save the world again!

Overcooked! 2 comes to Steam, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4 and Xbox One on August 7th 2018, and you can pre-order now to get the ‘Too Many Cooks’ pack, which contains FIVE bonus chefs – for free!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6zM7ZfonD-Q

So, if a fancy unicorn or a cheeky monkey are your spirit animal chefs, you’ll get them free with your pre-order (along with a calico cat, alien and walrus)!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32971870/9aa5e7e1c9edcbd208f03c963becce71124a7464.png[/img]

Interested in pre-ordering Overcooked! 2 and getting some extra chefs before the game’s launch on August 7th? Head to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/728880/Overcooked_2/]Steam store page[/url]!

notes.title: The Escapists Sale and The Escapists: The Walking Dead Free Survival Mode Update!
notes.notes:
[img= http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/388060/extras/capsule_main.png?t=1458828930]

[h1] The Escapists: The Walking Dead Free Survival Mode Update![/h1]

The TOP REQUESTED feature we’ve seen since the game launched is undeniably a survival mode. Lots of you wanted a chance to on The Walking Dead in an action packed game mode and we’re happy to announce that it’s here!

The Survival Mode update adds an all new gameplay mode where you must take on a herd of walkers, grunts and legends across three different levels set within The Walking Dead universe.

[h1]Features:[/h1][b]
•	Try to survive for as long as possible!
•	3 new survival maps set in Meriwether, Alexandria and Woodbury. 
•	Battle as Tyreese, Abraham and Michonne, whilst being supported by fellow survivors including iconic characters like Rick, Carl and Glenn.
•	New weapons and craftables such as the mini gun, sniper rifle and revolver
•	5 brand new Achievements
•	New Leaderboards to compete on.[/b]

[h1] Watch the trailer now![/h1]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?time_continue=4&v=bQmmUgfdTro

[h1]Skybound Insider Content![/h1]
Skybound Insider members will receive additional free content on PC. This exclusive content will enable the player to play as walker versions of Abraham, Michonne and Tyreese and will also unlock the Stun Gun weapon! notes.title: The Escapists Walking Dead Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Escapees and Survivors![/h1]

[img=https://www.team17.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/08/GreeneFamilyFarm_RV.png]

We’ve been continuing to work on making The Escapists: The Walking Dead the best experience possible and we’ve fixed a few issues that were affecting some players. 

[h1]Here’s a list of changes:[/h1][b]

[list]

 [*]Fixed an issue with Steam controllers not working

 [*]Fixed an issue where it was possible to play as other non-playable characters 

 [*]Fixed an issue where it was possible to become trapped if dropping into a locked room 

 [*]Fixed an issue where the Shotgun turns invisible if a pistol had been previously equiped

 [*]Fixed issues with Xbox one gamepads on Windows 10[/list][/b]

Thank you for you continued support and enthusiasm for The Escapists: The Walking Dead. 

Team17
